name: Sweden
prevalence_note: Polisen and PTS warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for Mobilt BankID or bankdosa codes, fake police collecting cards and jewellery, telecom contract tricks signed with BankID, and investment scams.

scams.name: Falsk säkerhetsavdelning: BankID och bankdosa
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for BankID or bankdosa codes
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department warns of a loan or card payment the owner did not make and asks to sign in with Mobilt BankID, read codes from the bankdosa or move money to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Swedish banks never call and ask customers to sign in with BankID, read bankdosa codes or move money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Säga att mobilen just startar om och be dem förklara en gång till, lugnt
Fråga vilken dag lånet ska ha tagits och på hur mycket

scams.name: Falska poliser hämtar kort och smycken
scams.name_en: Fake police collecting bank cards and jewellery
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer says burglars or identity thieves target the owner, asks for BankID verification and says plain-clothes staff will come to collect bank cards, codes, gold and jewellery.
scams.legit_en: The Swedish police never ask people to verify themselves with BankID by phone or collect cards, codes or valuables at home.
bait_tactics: Säga att nycklarna till skåpet ligger hos grannen och fråga när de tänkte komma
Fråga lugnt hur personen som kommer ser ut

scams.name: Falsk mobiloperatör: signera med BankID direkt
scams.name_en: Fake mobile operator pushing a BankID signature
scams.signals_en: A caller from a mobile operator promises a lower monthly cost or a network update and pushes the owner to sign a contract with BankID at once or lose the number today.
scams.legit_en: Operators do not shut numbers off the same day and never require a BankID signature during a cold call.
bait_tactics: Säga att glasögonen ligger i bilen och be dem läsa upp villkoren igen
Fråga vad det kostar efter första året

scams.name: Investeringsbedrägeri med krypto

red_flag_keywords.text: avgift för att få ut vinsten

scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a financial adviser promises returns on crypto, asks to install a remote-control program and later demands a tax or fee to pay out the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed advisers never ask clients to install remote-control programs or pay a fee to get their profit out.
bait_tactics: Säga att man skriver upp allt och fråga hur mycket man ska börja med
Fråga hur lång tid en utbetalning tar
